subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append behavior as `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool, and should #77127 be the landing branch instead of #102243?
rationale: The implementation is technically plausible, but the durable model-facing API shape and choice between competing PRs are maintainer product/API decisions that automation should not make.

options.title: Land one append-flag PR
options.body: Accept `append?: boolean` as the write-tool API, choose #77127 or #102243 as the canonical branch, and close the other as superseded after merge.

options.title: Request a different append API
options.body: Ask contributors to replace the boolean flag with a dedicated append tool or mode-style API before either branch lands.

options.title: Defer write-tool API expansion
options.body: Keep #40001 open but close both PRs if maintainers decide prompt/tooling changes outside the write API are the preferred direction.

recommendation.title: Land one append-flag PR
recommendation.body: Accept `append?: boolean` as the write-tool API, choose #77127 or #102243 as the canonical branch, and close the other as superseded after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the model-visible write-tool contract, and this owner is tied to the structured tool-definition and dynamic tool-list history.
